title: Provider Profile summary-first view with Change Info edit mode and Update flow

requirements.summary: Show a read-only provider profile summary by default (no editable inputs) for authenticated Service Providers on My Profile.
acceptanceCriteria: When the authenticated user role is Service Provider and they navigate to the Provider Profile page, the default view is a read-only summary (not an edit form).
The summary shows key provider details currently stored (at minimum: Name, Service Category, Hourly Rate, Phone Number, Description, Pinned Location, and Engagement Status).
No editable text inputs are shown in the default summary view.

file_operations.description: Refactor the Provider Profile page into a summary-first UI: default to a read-only summary section rendering key provider fields as plain text (not Input/Textarea/LocationPicker/Switch). Ensure the summary includes Name, Service Category, Hourly Rate, Phone Number, Description, Pinned Location (address + coordinates if desired), and Engagement Status (including remaining time when engaged). Use existing shadcn-ui composed components (e.g., Card, Button, etc.) for layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a provider-facing “Change Info” action to enter edit mode for allowed provider fields, with a Cancel action to discard changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible button labeled “Change Info” is present on the Provider Profile summary view.
Clicking “Change Info” enters an edit mode that allows the provider to modify only allowed fields (see non-editable bio-data requirement).
There is a clear way to exit edit mode without saving (e.g., “Cancel” returns to the read-only summary and discards unsaved local changes).

file_operations.description: Add an explicit page-level editMode state. On the summary view, render a prominent “Change Info” button that switches to editMode and initializes local draft state from the latest providerProfile. In editMode, render a “Cancel” button that exits editMode and resets/discards any unsaved local draft changes. Use existing shadcn-ui Button/Card building blocks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide an Update/Save Changes button in edit mode that saves allowed changes, with proper disabled/loading states, success/error feedback, and cache refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: In edit mode, an “Update”/“Save Changes” button is visible and triggers a backend update for the edited provider fields.
The button is disabled while a save is in progress, and re-enabled afterward.
On successful save, the UI returns to the read-only summary view and shows a success message in English.
On failure, the UI stays in edit mode and shows a user-friendly English error message.
After a successful save, the Provider Profile data shown in the summary reflects the latest backend values (React Query caches are invalidated/refetched as needed).

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook for saving provider profile edits via the existing backend capability (updateProviderProfile). Ensure it invalidates/refetches the current user profile query (and any provider detail query keys used elsewhere) after success, and translates common authorization/validation traps into user-friendly English errors.

In editMode, render an “Update”/“Save Changes” button wired to the new provider update mutation. Track a local draft of editable fields and compute a hasChanges flag versus the last fetched providerProfile; only enable the button when hasChanges is true and no save is in progress. Disable controls while saving. On success: show an English toast success message, exit editMode, and rely on query invalidation to refresh the summary. On error: keep editMode, show an English toast error message. Use existing shadcn-ui components and current toast system; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make provider bio-data fields read-only in both summary and edit experiences, and clearly explain why they cannot be changed.
acceptanceCriteria: Bio-data fields are displayed as read-only and cannot be edited in the UI (even in edit mode).
Backend update logic does not allow overwriting bio-data fields for an existing provider profile (server-side enforcement).
User-facing helper text in English explains that bio-data cannot be changed because it is taken from an ID document.
This change does not break existing onboarding/profile creation flows (initial creation can still set these fields, but later updates cannot modify them).

file_operations.description: Define and enforce a clear separation between non-editable bio-data fields (at minimum: Name and Phone Number) and editable fields. In summary view, show bio-data as plain text. In editMode, do not render editable controls for bio-data; instead show them as read-only display with an English helper note explaining they come from an ID document and cannot be changed. Ensure the save payload only includes allowed editable fields (rate, service category/business type, description, location, profile picture if supported) and never attempts to update bio-data. Use composed shadcn-ui components for helper text/layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove outdated Provider Profile messaging and replace with guidance matching the new summary-first + Change Info + Update flow.
acceptanceCriteria: The text “Note: Profile editing will be available in a future update...” is not shown on the Provider Profile page.
All user-facing guidance on the Provider Profile page is in English and accurately describes how to update allowed fields (via “Change Info” then “Update”).

file_operations.description: Remove the outdated note about profile editing being available in a future update. Replace it with concise English guidance that matches the new flow: view summary by default, click “Change Info” to edit allowed fields, then click “Update” to save (and use “Cancel” to discard). Use existing typography and shadcn-ui composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
